Content.SourceString: 向你道歉 抱歉
Content.LocalizedString: I owe you an apology—sorry.

Content.SourceString: 赔偿的流程具体由那家伙之后再通知你
Content.LocalizedString: That guy will fill you in on the compensation process later.

Content.SourceString: Exe？呃，没事。
Content.LocalizedString: Exe? Uh… never mind.

Content.SourceString: 不过你在这里，我是说，你在「现实」的态度和脾气……似乎和在「那里」的时候相比很有差距啊？
Content.LocalizedString: But your behavior here—I mean, in "reality"—seems pretty different from when you were "there," huh?

Content.SourceString: 因为要继续工作
Content.LocalizedString: It's because I have to continue working.

Content.SourceString: 还真是现实的理由啊。
Content.LocalizedString: That's a pretty practical reason, all right.

Content.SourceString: 怎么有种，即使是小时候性格恶劣、只活在自己世界里的人，踏上社会也不得不有所改变……的感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Why does this feel like even someone who was a bit of a handful as a kid has to change once they enter the real world…?

Content.SourceString: 啊不好意思，只是感想，这话并不是针对你？
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry—just thinking out loud. I wasn't specifically talking about you, alright?

Content.SourceString: 不介意
Content.LocalizedString: It's okay.

Content.SourceString: 事实
Content.LocalizedString: It's true.

Content.SourceString: 一回到这里，你有点像是「切换了运行模式」？
Content.LocalizedString: It's almost like you switch to a different "operating mode" as soon as you come back here, huh?

Content.SourceString: 控制情绪 也和管理数据差别不大
Content.LocalizedString: Controlling your emotions isn't that much different from managing data.

Content.SourceString: 在那家伙的地盘反正没有别人 怎样都没关系 肆无忌惮去做就行
Content.LocalizedString: There's nobody else on that guy's turf, so it's a free-for-all. No need to hold back.

Content.SourceString: 而在这边最基本的就是 首先控制住自己才能让办事效率提高 所以换成这种做法
Content.LocalizedString: Over here, I have to keep myself in check first. That's how you get things done more efficiently. So, I've changed the way I operate, too…

Content.SourceString: 而更高效地完成工作，省下时间，也都是为了你下一次的「空想故知」泯除计划吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You're grinding through work faster so you can save time for your next "Imaginary Old Friend" Nullification plan, right?

Content.SourceString: 对
Content.LocalizedString: Yes.

Content.SourceString: 和它约定过 没有特殊情况的话 尽量只占用工作之余的时间
Content.LocalizedString: I made a promise with it: barring any extenuating circumstances, I'd try to keep this to after-work hours.

Content.SourceString: 为了让这个数字变多 得快速解决掉更多的工作
Content.LocalizedString: If I want more free time, I need to finish my work faster.

OptionText.LocalizedString: No wonder you never clock out…

Content.SourceString: 怪不得别人都说从来看不到你下班……好恐怖……
Content.LocalizedString: No wonder everyone says they never see you clock out… That's kind of scary…

Content.SourceString: 就和放学后再去玩一样 下班后再处理私人事务罢了
Content.LocalizedString: It's just like waiting to play till after school—I just handle personal matters after work.

Content.SourceString: 以及 下次会把你或者妮夏有概率又来帮它这一点也计算在内
Content.LocalizedString: Next time, I'll factor in the possibility that you or Nitsa might help.

Content.SourceString: ……还真是爽快、毫不避讳的犯罪预告啊。
Content.LocalizedString: That's quite a blatant announcement of your next crime. You're not even trying to hide it.

Content.SourceString: 你们两个就只能，用这么奇怪的形式……运转下去吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is this strange arrangement really the only way you two can keep going?

Content.SourceString: 一如既往 没有问题
Content.LocalizedString: As usual, it's no big deal.

Content.SourceString: 呃，好吧……
Content.LocalizedString: Uh, okay…

Content.SourceString: 不问动机只从结果论去看，或许你是一个很优秀可靠的、为管理局发挥了巨大价值的E.T.D一队之长……
Content.LocalizedString: If we ignore your motives and judge you solely by your results, then perhaps one could say you're an excellent, reliable leader of ETD-6, and you've been a tremendous asset to the Bureau…

Content.SourceString: 只是对于隐藏在后面的真实动机，我是不会为你加油的。
Content.LocalizedString: But knowing the real motive behind all this, I won't be cheering you on.

Content.SourceString: 这也很正常
Content.LocalizedString: That's understandable.

Content.SourceString: 你……还真是已经平淡地接受了这一切啊。
Content.LocalizedString: You've accepted all this so calmly, haven't you?

Content.SourceString: 你花费了那么多时间和精力，甚至不惜致自己于死地的计划……
Content.LocalizedString: The plan you've put so much time and effort into, even at the risk of your life…

Content.SourceString: 因为所有我不能接受的事 已经发生完毕了
Content.LocalizedString: All of my biggest fears have already come to pass.

Content.SourceString: 无所谓
Content.LocalizedString: Regardless, it doesn't matter anymore.

Content.SourceString: 不用在意
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry about it.

Content.SourceString: 就算你这么说……
Content.LocalizedString: Even if you say that…

Content.SourceString: 唉，这家伙……
Content.LocalizedString: Ah, this guy…
